title: Unread counts sit on their tab
body: A pinned mail app, a pinned chat and an open forum whose titles carry unread counts. Before, only the title changed; now the count sits on each tab's icon, from the title, the Badging API or a dot on the favicon.

title: Links from pinned tabs open in a Peek
body: A link in a pinned mail app that opens a new tab, as Gmail's do. Before, it opened a tab and took you off the app; now it opens over the app in a Peek. Inside Little Ardia, new-tab links now stay in Little Ardia.

notes.text: GitHub's issue form: sign in first

title: Report a Problem, one sheet for everything
body: Help › Report a Problem… (⌥⇧⌘I). 0.2.44 opened a GitHub issue form in a new tab. Now one sheet takes bugs, slowness and ideas, with an optional page-free recording and a preview of exactly what is sent.

title: Organize tabs from the command line
body: ardia tabs lists every window, group and tab; ardia groups creates, nests, renames and recolours groups without changing the tab you're on. 0.2.44's CLI has neither command.

title: Profiles load when you open them
body: Eight profiles, idle after launch, then a switch to P4. With every profile started at launch they took 1,832 MiB; now only the one on screen starts, and the first switch to another takes about two seconds.

title: WebKit pages block ads and trackers
body: Daily Mail in a WebKit tab, headline and photos blurred. 0.2.44 loaded its display ads and a video ad; now uBlock Origin Lite's lists keep them out, and Site Controls counts what it blocked.

title: The page frame goes edge to edge
body: Settings › Appearance › Page Frame, a slider stepped from 9 pt to 0. Before, there was no such setting and the 9 pt frame always stayed; it's in onboarding too.

title: Bookmarks can hide
body: Show bookmarks off in Settings › General, then a click where the star was. Before, there was no such switch; now the button, the bar and the Bookmarks menu go, and Copy URL takes the star's place.

title: Settings › Privacy shows how you appear to us
body: An anonymous name and avatar stand in for your install's random ID, with Reset My Anonymous ID. View My Data saves the last 7 days of what Ardia logged to your Downloads folder.
reason: It lives in the Settings window, and this film records only the browser window of each hidden test instance.

title: Drop things where you are
body: Files, links and text dropped on the New Tab page open in that tab, from the Downloads popover too, and a .crx dropped anywhere in a window asks to install it.
reason: A drop needs a real drag from Finder. The test hook that fakes one only exists in debug builds, and 0.2.44 is a release build.

title: Live folder tabs go back to their item
body: A tab opened from a live folder keeps the item's page as its home, so Back to Pinned URL takes you back to it.
reason: Live folders read GitHub with a signed-in account, and test instances have no accounts.

title: Agents do more, in fewer steps
body: ardia browse read and script, HTML5 drag and drop, background tabs that keep drawing, ardia computer for your Mac's other apps, and ardia feedback for agents.
reason: These are terminal commands for agents; the app looks the same while they run.

title: Chromium 157
body: The engine moves from 156 to 157.0.8103.38 with Helium 0.21.1's privacy patches and Chrome 157's security fixes. Profiles, tabs, passwords, extensions and filters carry over.
reason: Pages look the same. The new engine is in the stable build; the after shots in this film were filmed on 0.2.45's nightlies, which still ran Chromium 156.

note: Before's warning drawn from what nightly.3 logged

dialogs.title: Close 5 tabs?
dialogs.message: This window has 5 tabs open in your Personal profile.

title: Closing your last window keeps it
body: Pinned tabs, five open tabs and a Weekend group; the red button, then Ardia in the Dock. Before, it asked "Close 5 tabs?" and the Dock gave a fresh window; now it closes without asking and comes back as it was.

note: Captured at 1 to 3 fps under load
title: Thousands of bookmarks no longer freeze Ardia
body: 2,500 bookmarks imported with the bar set to Always. 0.2.44 never drew the bar and ignored a tab switch for 40 s; now the import takes half a second and tab switches are instant.

title: ⌘A clears a whole folder
body: 300 imported bookmarks on the bookmarks page: a click on the first, ⌘A, then ⌫. 0.2.44 kept one row selected and ⌫ did nothing; now ⌘A selects the whole folder, ⌫ deletes it and Undo brings it back.

title: Auto-hide tabs remembers your choice
body: ⌘S hides the tabs, then ⌘N opens a new window. 0.2.44 kept the choice on that window only, so the new one brought the tabs back; now it's a setting, Settings › Tabs › Auto-hide tabs.

title: Tabs across the top get a hide button
body: With tabs across the top, two clicks on the toolbar's first button. 0.2.44 had no button there (that's Back, greyed out); now it hides and shows the strip, and its tooltip says Hide Tabs or Show Tabs.

title: Arrowing shows the suggestion in the field
body: ⌘L, "cr", then ↓ three times and Esc. In 0.2.44 only the highlight moved; now the field shows each row's query or address, as in Chrome and Dia, and Esc brings back what you typed.

title: Top Apps stay in their own profile
body: Personal and Work share browsing data. 0.2.44 merged their Top Apps, so unpinning a tile in Work took it out of Personal too. Sharing Top Apps is now off unless a profile turns it on.

title: Picky sites work
body: A YNAB-like test page running the same tamper checks on screen sharing. 0.2.44 failed them and showed Something Went Wrong on every load; now the budget loads. Apple Store guest checkout works too.

title: No screen picker without a click
body: A page asks to share the screen while it loads, and again from a frame, with no click. 0.2.44 opened Chrome's picker and set off screen-recording prompts; now nothing opens until you click.

title: Picture in Picture goes where you put it
body: A video that tells the browser it can't go into Picture in Picture, as YouTube TV's player does. 0.2.44's button did nothing; now it opens anyway. It also floats over full-screen apps and sits on any display.

title: Tiling window managers leave it alone
body: AeroSpace's rules over a workspace switch. 0.2.44's Picture in Picture counted as a dialog and was pulled back to Ardia's workspace; now it floats over every workspace.

title: Full screen works like Arc's
body: Full screen, at rest and through a menu bar reveal. 0.2.44 kept the window buttons up the whole time; now they hide until you point at the top, and come down with macOS's title bar.

title: A second Mac joining sync lists the first's profiles
body: Mac B's Settings › Sync, after it joined while Mac A's files were still downloading from iCloud. 0.2.44 never read them again and listed none of A's profiles; now they show up.

title: A window dragged to another display stays put
body: A drag onto a shorter second display on macOS 27. 0.2.44 shrank the window and stopped it following the pointer; now it keeps its size, lands where you drop it and snaps to the edges.

title: Signing in from an extension opens its own window
body: Stylus › Options › Sync to cloud › Google Drive › Connect. 0.2.44 put the sign-in page among your tabs and closed your window when it finished; now it opens in its own window.

title: Profile icons get room in the switcher
body: Five profiles with "Show profile icons instead of dots" on, a hover on School and a click on Music. Before, each icon sat in an 18 pt cell and the targets touched; now each gets 26 pt.

title: The hidden sidebar behaves at the edges
body: Sidebar hidden with the address bar in it, then a long press on Back. 0.2.44 opened the history menu under the sidebar and let it slide away; now it opens beside it. The corner flicker is gone too.

title: A click that drifts still counts
body: Two clicks on sidebar tabs where the pointer drifts 4 to 5 points before it lets go. Before, they read as tiny drags and nothing happened; now each opens its tab.

title: Several crashes are gone
body: At launch with thousands of tabs or on early macOS 26, loading certain images, closing a window or moving a tab between windows, an extension popup with no tab, and Cast remoting.
reason: Crashing 0.2.44 on purpose would put macOS's crash dialog on the owner's screen.

title: Website colour in the tab bar is the site's real one
body: With "Extend website color into tab bar" on, Perplexity's tab bar turned black and Linear's dark red, though both sites are light.
reason: It needs Perplexity and Linear themselves, and test instances only load local fixture pages.

title: Closing a window asks about the right tabs
body: Two windows that share tabs both close when you close them, and the warning counts only the tabs that will close.
reason: The warning is a native sheet, which a hidden test instance logs instead of showing.

title: Upscaling no longer stripes AV1 video
body: On M1 and M2 Macs, video upscaling drew stripes across AV1 video.
reason: This Mac isn't an M1 or M2, so it never striped here.

title: Clicking a tab no longer scrolls the sidebar
body: After switching to another profile's page, clicking a tab you could see scrolled the sidebar away from it.
reason: It needed a long scrolled tab list across profiles that the test sessions here don't recreate on demand.

title: Agents never act on your tab unasked
body: An agent's own reads and inspections open tabs of their own, and close leaves your tabs alone.
reason: It's a rule in the ardia command; there's nothing different to see unless an agent misbehaves.

title: Top Apps tiles look like 0.2.43's again
body: A swipe from the Red space to the Green one. 0.2.44 drew the tiles whiter, with a brighter edge; now their glass is back.

title: Hover cards leave at a group's header
body: A tab's hover card, then the pointer onto its group's header. 0.2.44 kept the card until the click; now it goes. Hover cards also sit under the top strip and keep off the page's edge.

title: Site panels close when you click away
body: Site Controls, then a click in the sidebar, then Esc. 0.2.44 kept the panel open through both; now either closes it. The ⌃Tab switcher lists only open tabs too.

title: A pinned tab away from home shows "/ title"
body: A pinned Notes row, then a click into one of its notes: a dimmed "/" says the pinned tab has left its page. Back to Pinned URL no longer sticks afterwards.

title: The command bar pulses in the site's colour
body: ⌘T, "bing" and Tab to search Bing: the bar now pulses in Bing's teal.

title: Shared Top Apps hold still
body: Two spaces that share Top Apps, and ⌃2 to Work. Before, the tiles slid out and back in; now only the tabs move.

title: The selected tab stands out on dark profiles
body: A near-black custom profile: the selected tab now reads lighter than the sidebar, on near-white ones too.

title: More small things on screen
body: A tab with a Peek shows its icon; the audio indicator holds 2 s; same-site swaps don't flash white; the camera dot leaves slept tabs; a black-icon tile shows its ring; tab-on-tab grouping is a setting.
reason: Each lasts a moment or needs a real camera, sound or drag; also a live folder's Completed list folds open, the Dock icon behaves under Tinted and Clear, and an extension's side panel takes focus.

title: And under the hood
body: Re-saving a password works; no recovery kit offered too early; Gemini in Chrome is off; crash reports (sharing on) cover page and GPU crashes; Copy Diagnostics names the focused window; ardia exec makes way for browse, pinned and history.
reason: None of these change what's on screen.
